excerpt.zh: 在一段局势紧张的日子后，[Root.Target.GetName]上的不满终于酿成了恐怖行动。尽管人员伤亡与财产损失微不足道，但居民已经开始质疑[Root.Owner.GetName]的保护他们的能力。
excerpt.en: After a period of mounting tension, the unrest on [Root.Target.GetName] has resulted in terrorist action. While casualties and property damage were minimal, faith in the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s ability to protect its citizens has been shaken.
